title: Hermite expansion of the Gaussian generator
statement: Let $f,g:\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ have Gaussian generator $g$. In the $L^2$ space for the product standard Gaussian measure, the series indexed by $\alpha\in\mathbb N^n$ with terms $|\alpha|\widehat f(\alpha)H_\alpha$ sums to $g$, where $|\alpha|=\sum_{j=1}^n\alpha_j$, $\widehat f(\alpha)$ is the Hermite coefficient of $f$, and $H_\alpha$ is the corresponding normalized Hermite function viewed as an $L^2$ element.
